source: UR Fall Detection Dataset (Kwolek & Kepski 2014, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), cam0 RGB, MediaPipe pose_landmarker_lite
input: normalized x,y from PoseLandmarker; x multiplied by image width/height (aspect) before geometry; NaN frames forward-filled (causal)
threshold_rule: OOF over 70 sequences: among thresholds with false alarms/h <= 1.0 pick max sensitivity; if none, best event F1; threshold re-selected on gated OOF (ungated v1 threshold was 0.775)
caveat: lab dataset, side camera ~ waist height, 70 sequences; FA/h estimated from 0.093 h of negatives

descent_gate.rule: alarm only if hip_drop_L (hip y at window end minus start, torso lengths, +y = down) > min; blocks a person already lying still (no descent in the window)
